type: post-hoc descriptive analysis of previously observed outcomes
controls: No rollout, fitting, policy change, threshold search, outcome-based sample selection or validation access. Graph pre-action fields only; compare existing three continuations at each same state.
limits: 16 routes, 8 training scenes, one simulator seed. Two alternatives chosen conditional on existing logits. Features are descriptive associations only, not evidence of predictive generalization or adaptive abstraction. Six-metric dominance gate remains unchanged.
